assessments.reasoning: I independently retrieved and verified the exact bytes of Learning Algol 68 Genie and inspected the cited passage (Cover, copyright leaf and Preface (physical PDF pp. 1–2, 11)). The cover names Algol 68 Genie 3.14 and editor Marcel van der Veer. The copyright leaf dates the book November 2026 and identifies the implementation. The preface describes the open-source hybrid for running ALGOL 68 programs or scripts.

challenge.method: Contrast the implementation, the book, the report reproduced in the book, and the GCC front end linked from the project site.
challenge.results: The preface expressly separates the new hybrid from the book and from vintage ports. The project site’s GA68 discussion describes a separate GCC front end that derives its parser from Genie.

limitations: This implementation identity is supported at version 3.14. The manual URL can serve a future version.
